# PasswordMenu

```ts
import { PasswordMenu } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Password Menu is static password-strength and policy feedback for an owning password field. It does not collect, validate, or store a password; pair it with Text Input or a future password-input field that owns those responsibilities. It composes Helper String for the status-icon requirement rows and optionally composes Input Label above the card when the menu needs to be associated with its owning field.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `strength` | `'empty' \| 'weak' \| 'medium' \| 'strong'` | `'empty'` | Password strength supplied by the owning password field. This component displays policy feedback only and never calculates or stores a password. |
| `title` | `string` | `'Pick a password'` | Title in the card header. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` | — | Overrides the visible strength status line. |
| `requirements` | `PasswordRequirement[]` | — | Requirement list; defaults to the four Figma criteria. |
| `metRequirementIds` | `string[]` | — | Explicitly satisfied requirement ids. When omitted, satisfaction follows the Figma strength progression; password fields should provide it when individual policy rules can be met out of order. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Optional field label above the menu, composed through InputLabel. Pass htmlFor to associate it with the owning password input. |
| `htmlFor` | `string` | — | The password field described by the optional external label. |
| `showLabelInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the optional label's 16px info icon. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Appends the optional label's "(required)" suffix. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Dims the optional label. The menu remains readable feedback. |


## Usage

```tsx
<PasswordMenu />
<PasswordMenu strength="weak" />
<PasswordMenu strength="medium" />
<PasswordMenu strength="strong" />
<PasswordMenu label="Password" htmlFor="new-password" showLabelInfo />
<PasswordMenu strength="strong" title="Your password is ready" />
<PasswordMenu requirements={customRequirements} strength="medium" />
<PasswordMenu requirements={customRequirements} metRequirementIds={['lower']} />
```

## Accessibility

- The card is a labelled <section>, with its title as the default accessible name; use aria-label only when a more specific name is needed.
- Strength is a real progressbar with numeric and text values, while the requirements are a semantic list. The status text is politely announced when the parent updates strength.
- The optional label uses the real InputLabel; pair it with htmlFor to identify the owning password field. Do not use the card title as a substitute for the password field's label.
- Requirement text stays primary-colored; semantic color is reinforced by the success/error icon, so status is not conveyed by color alone.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Compute strength from your actual server/client policy before passing it in. | Treat strength="strong" as proof a password is secure. |
| Keep the requirement list aligned with the policy enforced on submit. | Show requirements that the form does not enforce. |
| Associate an optional external label with the password input through htmlFor. | Use the card title as the password input label. |
| Use it for password-creation guidance. | Use it for PIN or OTP entry. |
